title: Coal Prices Rose While Steel Demand Fell
subtitle: Russian coking-coal prices rose across domestic and export markets as steel demand contracted, indicating an energy shortage rather than an industrial recovery.

supportingFacts.label: The source attributes the price rise to scarce fuel and energy rather than stronger steel production.
